title: Inter at Feyenoord without Bastoni — three points from three in the Champions League
description:
Inter cannot afford a draw in Rotterdam. Three points from three in the Champions League, and Bastoni is suspended.
Free daily newsletter in English: https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=63

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Nov 3): Bastoni is Inter's only suspended player at De Kuip; Inter and Feyenoord both have three points from three. Glenn Nyberg of Sweden referees.
CONFIRMED (Inter.it, Nov 2): Chivu says he believes in this squad, and that Benjamin Pavard and Ivan Provedel are available again.
REPORTED (Corriere dello Sport, Nov 2): Inter's three Premier League signings — Curtis Jones, John Stones and Djed Spence — have given Chivu almost nothing because of injuries.
REPORTED (Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInterNews, Nov 3): the papers expect Spence to keep the right-back place. Inter have published no lineup.
